questions.question:
Select the correct indirect form of the given sentence.

The student said to her, "I don't remember your name."

options.text: The student said to her that I did not remember her name.
The student said to her that he/she cannot remember her name.
The student told her that he/she did not remember her name.
The student told her that he/she do not remember her name.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is** "Option 3'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In **indirect speech**, we report what someone said without using their exact words. The** key points **to consider when converting direct speech to indirect speech are:
 
• **Pronouns:** The pronouns need to be changed to reflect the perspective of the speaker in the reporting clause.
 
• In this case, since the student is speaking, the pronouns **"I" and "her" **need to be changed accordingly.
 
• The options that use **"he/she" **are correct in this regard.
 
• **Tense changes:** The tense of the verb in the reported speech needs to be shifted back.
 
• The verb** "do not remember"** in the direct speech should be** changed to "did not remember"** in the** past tense** in the indirect speech.

Therefore, the **correct sentence** is:* 'The student told her that he/she did not remember her name.'*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Now, let's examine why the other options are** incorrect**:

 
 
• **Option 1** is incorrect because it uses "I" in the reported speech, which doesn't match the perspective of the student who is speaking.
 
• **Option 2** is incorrect because it uses "cannot remember" in the reported speech, which doesn't match the tense of the original statement.
 
• **Option 4** is incorrect because it uses "do not remember" in the reported speech, which doesn't match the tense of the original statement.

questions.question:
Choose the option that is the correct passive form of the sentence.

She ate the last slice of pizza.

options.text: She had eaten the last slice of pizza.
The last slice of pizza had been eaten by her.
The last slice of pizza was eaten by her.
The last slice was being eaten by her.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is** ****'The last slice of pizza was eaten by her.'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In the active sentence, "She ate the last slice of pizza," **the subject** "she" is **performing the action** of eating the pizza.
 
• To **convert** this sentence into the **passive voice**, we **need to make** the object of the active sentence ("the last slice of pizza") the subject of the passive sentence.
 
• The verb **"ate" **needs to be changed to its corresponding passive form.
 
• In **option 3**, "The last slice of pizza was eaten by her,"** the subjec**t of the passive sentence is "The last slice of pizza," and the **verb** is "was eaten."
 
• The** past participle form **of the verb "eat" is "eaten," which is used in the passive voice.
 
• Grammatically, in the passive voice, the subject receives the action rather than performing it. The **structure of the passive voice **is "be + past participle (verb) + by + agent (optional)."

Therefore, the **correct sentence** is:* 'The last slice of pizza was eaten by her.'*

questions.question:

R. not only underpinning a more sustainable approach to the achievement of

S. the other health targets, but allowing for a balance between them

• The **correct order **maintains a logical flow of ideas and creates a coherent sentence.
 
• **First, we have Q**, which introduces the contrast between UHC (Universal Health Coverage) and being seen as one target among many.
 
• Then, **P follows,** stating the belief that UHC should be seen as the linchpin of the health development agenda.
 
• **R comes next,** explaining that UHC not only underpins a more sustainable approach to achieving other health targets.
 
• **Finally, S** concludes the sentence, emphasizing that UHC allows for a balance between the other health targets.

Therefore, the **correct sentence** order is: **'QPRS.'**
